SRC-386:R001.text: Authority and source provenance (P0-1..5): synthetic Goal-Verifier reminders and agent_runtime continuations cannot authorize any effectful write, especially to foreign projects; an out-of-root write requires an authority check bound to the canonical target and owning project (aliases, symlinks, traversal, case, redirection); a recorded operator-required decision stays binding until the operator changes it; foreign host/protocol source is handed off, never edited; cross-project edits reconciled non-destructively

SRC-386:R002.text: Honest phases, tests and delivery (P1-6..11): recover real REA ticket status without backfilling an imaginary suite PASS; a deduplicated validation runner keyed by command+environment+subject hash that awaits an identical in-flight run instead of re-executing; preserve real nonzero exit codes through output filtering; save command/timestamps/subject hash/exit code/stdout; replace sleep polling with bounded event-driven wait; separate LOCAL_CHANGED/VERIFIED/REVIEWED/COMMITTED/PUBLISHED/INSTALLED; report an advisory-only reply contract as ADVISORY not as mechanically enforced

SRC-386:R003.text: Validation amplification and REA throughput (P1-12..16): profile measured costs before optimizing; incremental dependency-aware regeneration with content-hash invalidation and a retained full gate at batch boundaries; an 8-32 procedure pilot with durable per-function provenance and bounded semantics; separate cheap local checks from costly full-suite checks with a clean-rebuild equivalence test; verified BZCC public 1.8.5 coverage with separate version lineages and honest uncertainty
